**C.** Under UCC 2-207(1), an acceptance that is expressly made conditional on the offeror's assent to additional or different terms operates as a counteroffer, not an acceptance. Costco's confirmation said its acceptance was "conditional upon a loading charge," and Rainmaking never agreed to that charge, so the writings form no contract. D is wrong because the UCC has replaced the strict mirror-image rule. A and B are wrong because there is no contract on either price.

CONFIDENCE: 80
